name: PAD OLER Non-Home Discharge Validation
remarks: PAD / OLER NON-HOME DISCHARGE VALIDATION MODULE
External validation study for the Iannuzzi 2020 integer risk score for
non-home discharge (NHD) after open lower extremity revascularization.
STUDY DESIGN
Target  : inpatient open lower extremity revascularization (OLER), age >= 18
Outcome : non-home discharge (to SNF or IRF) — captured in
visit_occurrence.discharged_to_concept_id, NOT condition_occurrence.
Design  : prognostic model external validation, integer risk score.
See     : study_params.yaml, cohorts/target_surgery.sql, cohorts/outcome_nhd.sql
CLINICAL PATHWAY
Phase 1  Age guard (min 60) and PAD onset delay (onset ages 60–80)
Phase 2  PAD diagnosis — ConditionOnset + outpatient consultation
Phase 3  Covariates — nine Iannuzzi 2020 risk-score components.
Each is mapped 1:1 to a row in covariates/covariates.csv.
Demographic (read from person table — no state required):
age_60_69    [2 pts] — age at index 60–69
age_70_79    [4 pts] — age at index 70–79
age_ge80     [6 pts] — age at index >= 80
female       [1 pt ] — person.gender_concept_id = Female
nonwhite     [2 pts] — person.race_concept_id NOT IN white set
Clinical (explicit states in this module):
tissue_loss  [3 pts] — CLI tissue loss (ischemic ulcer / gangrene)
ambu_deficit [3 pts] — ambulatory deficit (any ambulatory device)
insulin_dep  [2 pts] — insulin-dependent DM (drug exposure)
anemia       [2 pts] — Hgb < 10 g/dL (LOINC, all patients measured)
Phase 4  Treatment strategy: 10% medical management / 90% OLER pathway
Phase 5  Pre-operative workup delay (30–180 days)
Phase 6  Inpatient OLER admission → procedure (bypass or endarterectomy)
Phase 7  Post-operative inpatient stay (3–10 days)
Phase 8  Discharge disposition gate — NHD vs home discharge
Non-home discharge (30%): 18% SNF (NUBC 03), 12% IRF/rehab (NUBC 62)
Home discharge   (70%): NUBC 01
DEMOGRAPHIC COVARIATES — WHY NO MODULE STATES
Synthea sets age, sex, and race at patient generation (synthea.properties)
before any module runs, so demographic prevalences cannot be set from inside
a Generic Module. The Iannuzzi pipeline reads these directly:
age decades → person.year_of_birth (computed at index visit)
female      → person.gender_concept_id
nonwhite    → person.race_concept_id (NOT IN white_race concept set)
Age distribution in this module is shaped by:
Age_Guard            — min 60 years
PAD_Onset_Delay      — uniform(0,20) yr after 60 → onset 60–80
Age_90_Check         — caps at 90 at PAD onset
Pre_OLER_Workup_Delay— 30–180 days from onset to index
This produces an index-age distribution roughly matching the Iannuzzi 2020
OLER cohort (target: ~40% age 60–69, ~35% age 70–79, ~15% age >=80).
RESEARCHER_ADJUSTS: change Age_Guard quantity, PAD_Onset_Delay range, and
Age_90_Check threshold together to shift the index-age mix.
Sex and race distributions follow Synthea generator defaults (configured in
synthea.properties via generate.demographics.* settings). To match Iannuzzi
2020 (~38% female, ~15–20% non-white), tune the generator config — this
module intentionally contains no demographic states.
NHD OUTCOME MODELLING
Non-home discharge is a property of the index inpatient encounter, not a
post-discharge condition. The outcome is captured via discharge_disposition on
the EncounterEnd state (NUBC code written to encounters.csv DISCHARGE column).
The ETL step 10b + post-INSERT fix-up in run_synthea_full_csv_builder_etl.R
maps NUBC codes to OMOP visit_occurrence.discharged_to_concept_id.
outcome_nhd.sql identifies outcome cohort members by discharged_to_concept_id
NOT IN the home concept set (NUBC 01/06, CMS PoS 8536, and Maps-to targets).
The Outcome_Onset / Outcome_Encounter / Outcome_Management states from the
generic template have been removed — there is no condition_occurrence for NHD.
NHD INCIDENCE ASSUMPTIONS
Overall NHD after OLER: 25%  (Iannuzzi 2020 derivation cohort overall ~ 20–25%)
Enriched to 30% for validation data richness. RESEARCHER_ADJUSTS in
Discharge_Disposition_Branch if a different incidence is preferred.
Non-home destination split (of NHD cases):
SNF (NUBC 03) : 60% of NHD cases → 0.30 * 0.60 = 18% of all patients
IRF (NUBC 62) : 40% of NHD cases → 0.30 * 0.40 = 12% of all patients
Home          : 70% of all patients

Entry point. Transitions immediately to Age_Guard, which holds
patients below the minimum PAD study age (60 years).
PAD / OLER is predominantly a disease of patients aged 60+. Guard set to
60 years to match the age distribution of the Iannuzzi 2020 derivation cohort.
Note: the target cohort SQL in study_params.yaml enforces min_age_at_index = 18,
so Synthea patients aged 18–59 would be valid targets if generated — this guard
simply focuses the simulation on the realistic PAD population.
RESEARCHER_ADJUSTS: change quantity to 18 to allow younger patients.
Random delay after age 60 before PAD develops. Uniform(0, 20) years
produces an onset age distribution of 60–80, consistent with the
vascular surgery cohort age profile in Iannuzzi 2020.
RESEARCHER_ADJUSTS: change high to 30 to allow onset up to age 90.
Cap to prevent simulation of implausibly aged open surgical patients.
Patients over 90 at PAD onset exit without procedure records.
RESEARCHER_ADJUSTS: change quantity to 120 to effectively disable the cap.

IANNUZZI 2020 COMPONENT: Tissue loss (CLI) — 3 points.
Tissue loss = ischemic wound, ulcer, or gangrene of the affected limb,
indicating critical limb ischaemia (CLI) as the operative indication.
Prevalence: ~21% of OLER patients (Iannuzzi 2020 Table II).
RESEARCHER_ADJUSTS: change distribution 0 to match your population estimate.
Maps to covariates.csv row: tissue_loss (domain = condition,
lookback -365 to 0 days, points = 3).
phenotype_library catalog entry: pad_indication_tissue_loss — uses BOTH
4029926 Ischemic ulcer  (SNOMED 13954005, include_descendants=TRUE)
4291464 Ischemic gangrene (SNOMED 402861007, include_descendants=TRUE)
as OR logic. We split the 21% population into ulcer (70%) + gangrene (30%)
via Tissue_Loss_Type_Branch so both ancestor branches are exercised in
synthetic data — without the split, gangrene cases would never be generated.
Split CLI tissue loss into ischemic ulcer vs ischemic gangrene to exercise
both ancestor concept IDs in covariate_concepts.csv. CLI literature mix:
~70% present with ischemic ulceration (more common, often distal foot)
~30% present with frank gangrene (more advanced, often toes/forefoot)
RESEARCHER_ADJUSTS: shift toward gangrene for end-stage CLI populations.

IANNUZZI 2020 COMPONENT: Ambulatory deficit — 3 points.
Ambulatory deficit = use of any ambulatory device (cane, walker, wheelchair)
documented before the index procedure.
Prevalence: ~20% of OLER patients (Iannuzzi 2020 Table II).
RESEARCHER_ADJUSTS: change distribution 0 to your population estimate.
OMOP capture varies by site — may appear as observation (assistive device)
or condition (gait disorder / mobility impairment). The covariate lookup
query covers both domains; confirm with your informatics team.
Maps to covariates.csv row: ambu_deficit (domain = observation,
lookback -365 to -1 days, points = 3).
Ambulatory deficit — use of any walking aid / mobility device.
SNOMED 165251008 'Walking aid use' maps to OMOP standard concept 4012645
(OMOP Observation domain). Verified against this vocabulary in
phenotype_library/catalog.yaml (ambulatory_deficit, 2026-05-12) and via
direct concept_id lookup on 2026-05-13 [vocab query — nhd-val].
State type is Observation (not ConditionOnset) because the OMOP standard
concept lands in the Observation domain. The Iannuzzi pipeline's

The catalog entry uses four SNOMED ancestors as OR logic with
include_descendants=TRUE (4012645 Walking aid use, 437643 Abnormal gait,
439405 Walking disability, 36714126 Difficulty walking). Walking aid use
is the most specific match to the Iannuzzi 'use of any ambulatory device'
definition; the other three are caught by the covariate query's OR set if
an EHR codes ambulation limitation differently.
value: exact quantity=1 represents presence of the observation
(no clinically meaningful numeric value — boolean presence/absence).
IANNUZZI 2020 COMPONENT: Insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus — 2 points.
Operationalised as active insulin drug exposure before the index procedure.
A drug-exposure approach is preferred over condition codes because SNOMED
does not cleanly distinguish Type 1 from Type 2 DM on insulin.
Prevalence: ~16% of OLER patients (Iannuzzi 2020 Table II).
RESEARCHER_ADJUSTS: change distribution 0 to your population estimate.
Maps to covariates.csv row: insulin_dep (domain = drug,
lookback -365 to -1 days, points = 2).
Insulin order within the open outpatient diagnosis encounter.
Represents ongoing insulin use documented at the preoperative visit.
RxNorm 274783 'insulin glargine' (Ingredient) — long-acting basal insulin,
OMOP concept 1502905. Matches the 1 unit/day once-daily dosage modelled
below. Verified against this vocabulary on 2026-05-13 [vocab query — nhd-val].
OMOP rollup: insulin glargine is a descendant of ATC 21600713 'INSULINS
AND ANALOGUES' (catalog entry insulin_dependent_diabetes_drug, verified
2026-05-12). covariates/covariate_concepts.csv row insulin_dep should
carry concept_id 21600713 with include_descendants=TRUE so that all
10,053 insulin formulations (glargine, aspart, NPH, etc.) are captured
regardless of which RxNorm ingredient Synthea generates.
dosage: 1 unit/day represents a once-daily long-acting dose; adjust
if simulating rapid-acting or mixed insulin regimens.
The medication spans the pre-operative period and satisfies the
lookback window (-365 to -1 days) in covariates.csv.
IANNUZZI 2020 COMPONENT: Anemia (Hgb < 10 g/dL) — 2 points.
Generates a haemoglobin measurement for ALL patients (standard
pre-surgical workup). The 11% anemic branch produces a low Hgb value
(5.5–9.9 g/dL); the 89% non-anemic branch produces a normal value
(10.0–17.0 g/dL). Both result in an Hgb observation record in
measurement_occurrence, which the pipeline reads via
query_anemia_covariate_counts().
missing_is_negative = FALSE in covariates.csv, so patients without an
Hgb measurement would be flagged as unknown. Generating Hgb for all
patients avoids this ambiguity in the synthetic dataset.
LOINC 718-7 (Hemoglobin [Mass/volume] in Blood) confirmed against
this vocabulary in pad-oler-macce-val [vocab query — macce-val].
RESEARCHER_ADJUSTS: change distribution 0 to your population estimate.
Iannuzzi 2020: ~11% prevalence of Hgb < 10 g/dL in OLER patients.
Maps to covariates.csv row: anemia (domain = measurement,
lookback -365 to -1 days, points = 2, missing_is_negative = FALSE).
Haemoglobin below 10 g/dL — anemia threshold for the Iannuzzi score.
Range 5.5–9.9 g/dL represents a clinically meaningful anaemia spectrum
in pre-surgical vascular patients (severe to moderate anaemia).
LOINC 718-7 confirmed [vocab query — macce-val].
Normal haemoglobin — patient does not meet anaemia criterion.
Range 10.0–17.0 g/dL covers the normal and mildly reduced spectrum.
Generating a normal Hgb value ensures every patient has a measurement
record, preventing missing_is_negative = FALSE from marking patients unknown.
LOINC 718-7 confirmed [vocab query — macce-val].

NHD OUTCOME GATE — discharge destination decision point.
Non-home discharge rate: 30% (enriched from Iannuzzi 2020's ~20-25% overall
to provide richer NHD events for validation).
18% → SNF (skilled nursing facility, NUBC 03)
12% → IRF (inpatient rehab facility, NUBC 62)
70% → Home (routine discharge, NUBC 01)
RESEARCHER_ADJUSTS: adjust distributions to match the NHD prevalence in
your validation population or to change the NHD enrichment level.
Match the SNF vs. IRF split to the disposition mix at your site.
OMOP mapping: NUBC codes are written to encounters.csv DISCHARGE column
by the synthea-pad fork. ETL step 10b + post-INSERT fix-up maps them to
visit_occurrence.discharged_to_concept_id via the OMOP vocabulary
(UB04 Pt dis status → Maps to → CMS Place of Service).
NUBC 01 → OMOP UB04 concept 32210 → CMS PoS 8536 (Home)
NUBC 03 → OMOP UB04 concept 32212 → CMS PoS 8546 (Skilled Nursing Facility)
NUBC 62 → OMOP UB04 concept 32228 → CMS PoS 8920 (Comprehensive IRF)
Discharge to skilled nursing facility (SNF) — non-home discharge.

discharged_to_concept_id will NOT be in the home concept set.

Discharge to inpatient rehabilitation facility (IRF) — non-home discharge.
NUBC code 62 maps to OMOP UB04 Pt dis status concept 32228 (typically
